import Mathlib
import Aesop

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem aime_1983_p3 (f : ℝ → ℝ)
  (h₀ : ∀ x, f x = x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 30) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)))
  (h₁ : Fintype (f ⁻¹' {0})) : (∏ x ∈ (f ⁻¹' {0}).toFinset, x) = 20 := by
  set a := -9 + Real.sqrt 61 with ha
  set b := -9 - Real.sqrt 61 with hb
  have h61_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 61 := by norm_num
  have h61_sq : Real.sqrt 61 ^ 2 = (61 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt h61_nonneg
  have hsqrt61_nonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 61 := Real.sqrt_nonneg 61
  have hsqrt61_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt 61 := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 61)
  have h_char : ∀ x : ℝ, f x = 0 ↔ x ^ 2 + 18 * x + 20 = 0 := by
    intro x
    have hx := h₀ x
    constructor
    · intro hf
      have hf_eq : x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 30) - 2 * Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)) = 0 := by
        rw [← hx]; exact hf
      by_cases hg : 0 ≤ x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)
      · have hsq : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)) ^ 2 = x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45) :=
          Real.sq_sqrt hg
        have hsnn : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
        nlinarith
      · push_neg at hg
        have hsqrt_zero : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)) = 0 :=
          Real.sqrt_eq_zero_of_nonpos (le_of_lt hg)
        rw [hsqrt_zero] at hf_eq
        nlinarith
    · intro hp
      have hg25 : x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45) = 25 := by nlinarith
      have hsqrt25 : Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + (18 * x + 45)) = 5 := by
        rw [hg25]
        have h5_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 := by norm_num
        have h25_eq : (25 : ℝ) = 5 ^ 2 := by norm_num
        rw [h25_eq, Real.sqrt_sq h5_nonneg]
      rw [hx, hsqrt25]
      nlinarith
  have h_roots : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ 2 + 18 * x + 20 = 0 ↔ x = a ∨ x = b := by
    intro x
    constructor
    · intro hp
      have h1 : (x + 9) ^ 2 = 61 := by nlinarith
      have h2 : (x + 9 - Real.sqrt 61) * (x + 9 + Real.sqrt 61) = 0 := by
        nlinarith [h61_sq]
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h2 with h | h
      · left; rw [ha]; linarith
      · right; rw [hb]; linarith
    · intro h
      rcases h with rfl | rfl
      · rw [ha]; nlinarith [h61_sq]
      · rw [hb]; nlinarith [h61_sq]
  have h_mem_iff : ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ f ⁻¹' {0} ↔ x = a ∨ x = b := by
    intro x
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, h_char, h_roots]
  have h_a_ne_b : a ≠ b := by
    rw [ha, hb]
    intro h
    have : Real.sqrt 61 = 0 := by linarith
    linarith [hsqrt61_pos]
  have h_toFinset_eq : (f ⁻¹' {0}).toFinset = {a, b} := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_toFinset, h_mem_iff, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  calc ∏ x ∈ (f ⁻¹' {0}).toFinset, x
      = ∏ x ∈ ({a, b} : Finset ℝ), x := by rw [h_toFinset_eq]
    _ = a * b := by
        have h_eq : ({a, b} : Finset ℝ) = insert a {b} := by ext y; simp
        rw [h_eq]
        rw [Finset.prod_insert (by simp [h_a_ne_b])]
        simp
    _ = 20 := by
        rw [ha, hb]
        nlinarith [h61_sq]
